confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lima's price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which vary by district and season. Lima's July is not a peak-season month, so accommodation values assume ordinary demand. FX was taken from an RBA exchange-rates page snippet dated 15 October 2026 (A$1 = US$0.6955) found in search. I could not open the RBA table directly, and a 16 October value could not be verified, so the 15 October observation is used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Latin American capitals with similar visitor districts (Miraflores and Barranco as the reference areas), such as Bogota and Quito, adjusted down for Lima's generally lower restaurant prices and up or down for hotel and hostel levels by star tier. Drink anchors use the typical local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine ratio because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker than for beer and meals.
